verses: Alif Laam Meem
Bila-shuba uss kitab ka utarna tamam jahano kay perwerdigar ki taraf say hai

Kiya yeh kehtay hain kay uss ney ussay gharr liya hai. (nahi nahi) balkay)yeh yeh teray rab Taalaa ki taraf say haq hai takay aap unhen darayen jin kay pass aap say pehlay koi daraney wala nahi aaya. Takay woh raah raast per aajayen

Allah Taalaa woh hai jiss ney aasman o zamin ko aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai sab ko chhe din mein peda ker diya phir arsh per qaeem hua, tumharay liye uss kay siwa koi madadgar aur sifarshi nahi. Kiya phir bhi tum naseehat hasil nahi kertay
Woh aasman say ley ker zamin tak (her) kaam ki tadbeer kerta hai. Phir (woh kaam) aik aisay din mein uss ki taraf charh jata hai jiss ka andaza tumhari ginti kay aik hazar saal kay barabar hai
Yehi hai chupay khulay ka jannay wala, zabardast ghalib boht hi meharban
Jiss ney nihayat khoob banaee jo cheez bhi banaee aur insan ki banawat mitti say shuroo ki
Phir uss ki nasal aik bey wuqat pani kay nichor say chalaee
Jissay theek thaak ker kay uss mein apni rooh phonki, ussi ney tumharay kaan aankhen aur dil banaye (uss per bhi) tum boht hi thora ehsan mantay ho
Unhon ney kaha kiya jab hum zamin mein mill jayen gay kiya phir naee pedaeesh mein aajayen gay? Balkay)yeh (baat yeh hai) kay woh log apney perwerdigar ki mulaqat kay munkir hain
Keh dijiye! kay tumhen maut ka farishta fot keray ga jo tum per muqarrar kiya gaya hai phir tum sab apney perwerdigar ki taraf lotaye jao gay

Kaash kay aap dekhtay jab kay gunah gaar log apney rab Taalaa kay samney sir jhukaye huye hun gay, kahen gay aey humaray rab! hum ney dekh liya aur sunn liya abb to humen wapis lota dey hum nek aemaal keren gay hum yaqeen kerney walay hain
Agar hum chahatay to her shakhs ko hidayat naseeb farma detay, lekin meri yeh baat bilkul haq ho chuki hai kay mein zaroor zaroor jahannum ko insano aur jinno say per kerdoon ga
Abb tum apney uss din ki mulaqat kay faramosh ker denay ka maza chakho, hum ney bhi tumhen bhala diya aur apney kiye huye aemaal (ki shamat) say abdi azab ka maza chakho

Humari aayaton per o hi eman latay hain jinhen jab kabhi unn say naseehat ki jati hai to woh sajday mein gir partay hain aur apney rab ki hamd kay sath uss ki tasbeeh parhtay hain aur takabbur nahi kertay hain
Unn ki kerwaten apney biostaron say alag rehti hain apney rab ko khof aur umeed kay sath pukartay hain aur jo kuch hum ney unhen dey rakha hai woh kharach kertay hain
Koi nafs nahi janta jo kuch hum ney unn ki aankhon ki thandak unn kay liye posheedah ker rakhi hai, jo kuch kertay thay yeh uss ka badla hai
Kiya woh jo momin ho misil uss kay hai jo fasiq ho? Yeh barabar nahi ho saktay
Jin logon ney eman qabool kiya aur nek aemaal bhi kiye unn kay liye hameshgi wali jannaten hain, mehmandaari hai unn kay aemaal kay badlay jo woh kertay thay

Lekin jin logon ney hukum adooli ki unn ka thikana dozakh hai. Jab kabhi uss say bahir nikalna chahayen gay ussi mein lota diye jayen gay. Aur keh diya jaye ga kay apney jhutlanay kay badlay aag ka azab chakho
Bil-yaqeen hum unhen qareeb kay chotay say baaz azab uss baray azab kay siwa chakhayen gay takay woh lot aayen
Uss say barh ker zalim kaun hai jissay Allah Taalaa ki aayaton say waaz kiya gaya phir bhi uss ney unn say mun pher liya, (yaqeen mano) kay hum bhi gunah gaaron say intiqam lenay walay hain
Be-shak hum ney Musa ko kitab di, pus aap ko hergiz uss ki mulaqat mein shak na kerna chahaiye aur hum ney ussay bani israeel ki hidayat ka zariye banaya
Aur jab unn logon ney sabar kiya to hum ney unn mein say aisay paishwa banaye jo humaray hukum say logon ko hidayat kertay thay, aur woh humari aayaton per yaqeen rakhtay thay
Aap ka rab unn (sab) kay darmiyan unn (tamam) baaton ka faisla qayamat kay din keray ga jin mein woh ikhtilaf ker rahey hain

Kiya uss baat ney bhi unhen hidayat nahi di kay hum ney unn say pehlay boht si ummaton ko halak ker diya jin kay makano mein yeh chal phir rahey hain. Uss mein to (bari) bari nishaniyan hain. Kiya phir bhi yeh nahi suntay?

Kiya yeh nahi dekhtay kay hum pani ko banjar (ghair abad) zamin ki taraf baha ker ley jatay hain phir uss say hum khetiyan nikaltay hain jissay unn kay chopaye aur yeh khud khatay hain, kiya phir bhi yeh nahi dekhtay?
Aur kehtay hain kay yeh faisla kab hoga? Agar tum sachay ho (to batlao)
Jawab dey do kay faislay walay din eman lana bey emaanon ko kuch kaam na aaye ga aur na unhen dheel di jaye gi
Abb aap unn ka khayal chor den aur muntazir rahen. Yeh bhi muntazir hain
